messages:
Ava L: quick check - noticed when tabbing into ghost buttons on dark panels the focus halo bleeds outside the 8px card radius. screenshot: https://img.redwood/mock/ghost-bleed.png :eyes:
Samir: repro: Console -> Workspace -> Members modal -> tab through footer actions. Ghost btn focus is an outer ring that clips awkwardly on rounded corners in compact mode.
Priya: confirmed on Chrome + Safari. suspect we reuse the same outer focus token for all surfaces. dark surfaces need an inset approach.
Miguel: tried a quick local: `box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,0.06)` fixes bleed but reduces perceived affordance. maybe pair with slight background tint on hover.
Noor: ping on keyboard flow: when row actions collapse to kebab on <=720px the tab order goes row -> kebab -> open menu -> click action -> modal opens but focus lands on modal container rather than first input. that breaks trap expectations.
Samir: likely race between modal mount and focus call. trap lib expects visible + mounted DOM before activating. our opener still holds aria-hidden=false momentarily.
Priya: simple dev test: open modal via kebab, quickly press tab to reproduce. reconfirmed.
Miguel: patch idea: when opening from transient affordances, set `aria-hidden` on background then use `setTimeout(..., 0)` or `requestAnimationFrame` before calling `focus()` on the first tabbable. also ensure we call `trap.activate()` after mount.
Ava L: UX decision: toasts for table actions (Copied/Delete) are currently anchored top-right and overlap the inline action strip on dense rows. should toasts avoid overlap by shifting or by pushing layout?
Noor: prefer non-disruptive float. pushing table content causes layout jank. propose a token `--toast-stack-offset-y` and compute: `calc(var(--toast-base) + var(--action-strip-height))` when action strip present. small responsive rule for dense tables to increase base offset.
DesignBot: a11y check: ghost-btn hover contrast on dark panel measured 3.8:1 (target 4.5). recommendation: either increase hover background to #ffffff0a or add underline/underline-dash for affordance.
Samir: proposed action list:
- change focus shadow to inset for ghost buttons on elevated dark surfaces (PR queued)
- add hover fill tweak to meet 4.5:1 or alternative underline treatment (design to pick)
- fix modal open sequence: ensure body hidden, mount, then activate focus trap + focus first input (small rAF)
- introduce `--toast-stack-offset-y` token and responsive rule for dense table rows
- run manual keyboard walkthroughs and re-run a11y scans
Ava L: I'll write a short design note with before/after screenshots and token samples, and tag owners: @Samir for PR, @Priya for keyboard QA, @Miguel for toast token. thanks all :thumbsup:
